author: TheMasterClock
body: Hello everyone! So I was thinking of an idea I thought back when the new forums came when Avicore came out. Notifications. Might sound too YouTube/Facebook,ish but I think it can help a lot. Usually I post a forum post and then I might get replies back but I don't go back because the other thread because I didn't know I got a reply. So just try to think about it.
